commit.subject: LU-10026 tests: sanity-compr/1000d failure for ARM client
commit.message:
LU-10026 tests: sanity-compr/1000d failure for ARM client

aarch64 has 64K page size and compression chunk size could be adjusted
upward if it's original setting value is equal to page size, so
the test should be refined to get the actual chunk size be set.

Test-Parameters: forjanitoronly
DDN-bug-id: EX-7536
Signed-off-by: Bobi Jam <bobijam@whamcloud.com>
Signed-off-by: Marc Vef <mvef@whamcloud.com>
Change-Id: Ide2f91e255ba886f9c1e18d1e1fe89c589f3bca1
